evidence.quote: DM: And… Ayveen and Edric are in a… back porch of the house, where they've stumbled into a Rakshasa, a giant tiger person, smoking a pipe, who's told them that he has figured out the story of the Lord of the party, the lord of the manor here, and is willing to trade it. DM: Tarek, as you… cross through one of the rooms in the manor, he catches your eye and waves you over with an immense tiger paw, says, “Come, come, we were just speaking of you, I believe. Your friends have, made a deal in your name. You have keys on you.”

DM: He… brings his whole face over very close, and takes out a pair of spectacles and puts them on, and looks long and deep at each of the keys. Takes off his spectacles, sits back in his chair, takes a long puff on the pipe that he's smoking from, and says, “Mmm… this is… this is a delicious story. A delicious story.”
